summary.headline: Six open deals have close dates already in the past and a third of the pipeline has no next step — the forecast can't be trusted yet.
summary.narrative: As of 2026-06-08, six open opportunities are past their close date, several in late stages with no recent activity. Next steps are blank on a third of open deals. Re-baseline close dates and require next steps before any AI reads this pipeline as truth.

findings.title: Six open deals are past their close date
findings.what_we_found: OPP-2003 (Negotiation, due 2026-01-15), OPP-2006 (Proposal, due 2025-12-31), OPP-2010 (Negotiation, due 2026-01-20), OPP-2013 (Proposal, due 2026-01-10), OPP-2016 (Negotiation, due 2026-01-31) and OPP-2019 (Proposal, due 2026-01-25) are all open with close dates months in the past.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: A forecast model trained on these dates would treat long-dead timelines as live, inflating expected revenue and mis-timing any AI-driven follow-up.
the_fix: Have each owner re-baseline the close date or mark the deal Closed Lost.
Add a save rule requiring a future close_date to keep an opportunity open.
Re-run this check until the past-due rate is near zero.
findings.evidence: close_date < 2026-06-08 while stage is not Closed Won/Lost.

findings.title: A third of open deals have no next step
findings.what_we_found: Open opportunities including OPP-2003, OPP-2004, OPP-2006, OPP-2009, OPP-2011, OPP-2013, OPP-2017 and OPP-2019 have a blank next_step.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: An AI assistant has nothing to summarise, remind on, or act against — the most basic forward signal is missing.
the_fix: Make next_step required to save an open opportunity.
Prompt owners to fill next steps on the currently blank open deals.
Treat a blank next step as a stalled-deal trigger for manager review.
findings.evidence: next_step is empty on 7 of 17 open opportunities.

findings.title: Late-stage deals with no recent activity
findings.what_we_found: OPP-2003 is in Negotiation but its most recent logged activity is the renewal kickoff on 2025-12-02 — over six months stale. OPP-2010 (Negotiation) last logged activity 2025-12-12.
findings.why_it_blocks_ai: Stage implies active negotiation; the activity log says the deal has gone quiet. An AI reading stage as momentum would mis-prioritise these as hot.
the_fix: Add an activity-recency rule per late stage (e.g. Negotiation requires activity within 14 days).
Surface mismatched deals to the owner to either re-engage or re-stage.
Confirm true status before any AI summarisation runs on these records.
findings.evidence: Negotiation-stage opps with newest activity dated 2025-12-02 / 2025-12-12.
